about_the_game:
The Year is 3023. Technology has peaked. Humanity is on the brink.

In a world where technological advancement has gone too far, computer viruses have transcended the digital realm. These malevolent entities now take terrifying physical forms, wreaking havoc in the real world. Their origin is shrouded in mystery, but their purpose is clear: destruction.

When all else fails, humanity turns to its last line of defense—the Angel Unit.

You are one of them. A cybernetic operative trained to exterminate these monstrosities with brutal efficiency. Your mission is simple:
ERASE THEM ALL.

🔪 Brutal Dismemberment Mechanics

  • Slash and dismember enemies with precision using advanced melee weapons. Feel the weight and impact of every strike as enemies crumble before you.

👾 Terrifying Cyber-Horror Atmosphere

  • Navigate through hauntingly immersive environments filled with tension, danger, and the unknown. Every shadow hides a threat, every corridor could be your last.

🎯 Tactical Combat Gameplay

  • Combine ranged and melee combat to survive waves of physical viruses. Utilize your tools and skills to outthink and overpower enemies in close-quarters combat.

🌆 Cyberpunk World

  • Immerse yourself in a dystopian future where neon-lit corridors, polluted fog, and oppressive megastructures paint a chilling picture of technological decay.

🤖 Companion Droid

  • You're not alone. A loyal droid companion assists sometimes you in your mission, providing backup, insight, and a glimmer of humanity in this cold, digital apocalypse.

🎮 VR-Exclusive Gameplay

  • Designed from the ground up for VR, experience unparalleled immersion. Feel the adrenaline as you dodge, slash, and shoot your way through a relentless onslaught.

Infiltrate infested facilities, unravel the truth behind the virus outbreak, and stop the spread before it’s too late. But beware—what lies at the core of this mystery may change everything you thought you knew.

Are you ready to wield your blade, erase the enemy, and face the horrors of the digital apocalypse?
The Angel Unit is waiting.

name: Code angel Reloaded VR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 series / Ryzen 5 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 15 series / AMD RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Quest 2 ( PCVR ) / equivalent or latest
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: intel i7 series / Ryzen 7 series
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeGorce RTX 3070 / RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Quest 2 ( PCVR ) / equivalent or latest

short_description: A cyberpunk horror VR shooter where computer viruses take physical form. Slash and dismember enemies, navigate neon-lit corridors, and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak. As part of the Angel Unit, humanity's last hope, your mission is clear: ERASE THEM ALL.
